newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae buys its own shares in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Sonae buys its own shares in Lisbon.

text.p: Retail to wood products holding Sonae Investimentos bought 90,000 of its own shares on Wednesday, 80,000 of them from a subsidiary company, a senior company official said.
Executive board member Edgar Pinto Ribeiro said that 10,000 shares were bought on the Lisbon exchange.
He said that the company needed just 20,000 more shares to reach its target of buying one million. Sonae was trading 20 escudos higher at 4,460 escudos at 1506 GMT.

Pinto Ribeiro said the operation was launched to build up a stock of shares for use in the planned group reorganisation at the end of the year when Sonae Investimentos' industrial interests will be spun off into another company.
Last week, Sonae announced that it had transferred 573,000 shares from various subsidiaries into its own portfolio at 4,500 escudos per share.
